entries.request: Freeze extraction policy and apply pre-MD 1W60 stability gate without PCNA method selection.
entries.rationale: Highest predeclared composite score among eligible policies; no PCNA inputs read during select-policy.
follow_up: Human Gate-6 approval required before any MD.
entries.notes: Non-human process decision only. This is not human Gate-6 approval.

entries.request: Apply a post-pass stronger internal robustness standard without tuning on PCNA or starting MD.
entries.decision: Keep the current frozen policy; do not freeze a replacement, do not retrain, and do not start production MD.
entries.rationale: The stricter >=0.75 mean-Jaccard target was adopted after the 0.6792 result. Independent LOPO/bootstrap/grid analysis did not identify a materially better policy robust enough to justify a new one-shot PCNA evaluation. Ranking diagnostics do not justify retraining.
follow_up: Expand or strengthen the independent non-PCNA validation benchmark before production MD if the stronger internal release standard remains required.
Do not use 1W60 stability to tune extraction parameters.
Human Gate-6 approval remains required before any MD.
entries.notes: Non-human process decision only. This is not human Gate-6 approval.

entries.request: Final benchmark-expansion pass before MD readiness decision.
entries.decision: Keep current independently frozen extraction policy; do not retrain; proceed to control-first MD after Gate-6 approval.
entries.rationale: No additional eligible independent non-PCNA structures survived strict gate; existing LOPO/bootstrap did not justify replacement; PCNA evidence supports same physical pocket core with boundary uncertainty.
follow_up: Human Gate-6 approval required before MD preparation/production.
